claims.claim: CMP_GT prints 01 iff a > b over {0,1,2}^2, on the Malbolge Classic runtime
claims.evidence: 9/9 ordered pairs correct on both engines, bit-exact outputs and identical step counts

claims.claim: The VM core is intact on the CMP_GT image (push/out, 2-slot LIFO order, halt)
The 2026-10-15 result is reproducible and has not drifted
claims.evidence: all 12 step counts identical to gt_12_12_harness.json (ts 2026-10-15T03:07:24Z)
out of the claimed domain by design; the kernel classifies b into three ternary classes

references: vm_malbolge/LT_STATUS.md §11 (Finding 74, the symmetric CMP_LT milestone) and §12 (re-verification)
note: Independent re-verification of the CMP_GT 12/12 milestone on this host, 20 days after the original run. No image was rebuilt: the committed canonical image was executed as-is. The LMAO build non-determinism (Finding 62) does not apply here — no rebuild was performed.
